reasons.framing: The brief gives subject action only; it does not request a specific camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement. Framing therefore follows the reference.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, hue change, saturation, or tonal-contrast treatment is requested. The live-action cinematic reference governs the palette.
